definitions.explanation: A group of people traveling or acting together as a unit, often a delegation or the people accompanying a central figure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧{一行|いっこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{一行|いっこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The group headed for the sightseeing spot by bus.

examples.japanese: ⟦{視察団|しさつだん}→視察団：24114_shisatsudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一行|いっこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: The inspection delegation visited factories in various regions.

notes:
Counts a group moving as a unit, often with a leader: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧＋{一行|いっこう} (⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧{一行|いっこう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一行|いっこう}⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧: "your party" (polite, on reservations)
- {一行|いっこう}{六名|ろくめい}: a party of six

NOTE ON READING:
Read いっこう in this "group" sense. The same kanji read いちぎょう means "one line (of text)."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧: group; party — larger and more organized
- ⟦{一団|いちだん}→一団：18271_ichidan⟧: a body of people — emphasizes a single cluster
